Write a new Tamil story for "கதை நேரம்" about the theme: sharing.

Cast (use only these characters, refer to them in "characters" by their id; kavin leads the story):
- id "kavin": கவின், a baby elephant. Looks: a small round baby elephant with soft blue-grey skin, big floppy ears with pink insides, a short curly trunk, bright curious eyes and a red-and-yellow striped scarf. Personality: curious, cheerful and caring; asks lots of questions and loves helping friends
- id "mittu": மிட்டு, a parrot. Looks: a little green parrot with a bright red curved beak, a yellow chest patch, blue-tipped wings and a tiny orange flower tucked behind one eye. Personality: chatty and funny; loves singing and sometimes talks before thinking
- id "chinnu": சின்னு, a palm squirrel. Looks: a tiny brown palm squirrel with three cream stripes down its back, a big fluffy tail and a small green satchel across its chest. Personality: quick, clever and a little shy; good at noticing small things
- id "aamai_thatha": ஆமை தாத்தா, a tortoise. Looks: a gentle old tortoise with a domed olive-green shell with honey-coloured patterns, round spectacles and a soft white beard. Personality: calm, patient and wise; tells the friends gentle lessons with a smile

Choose one moral from this list, or a close gentle variation of one:
- Sharing makes everyone happier.
- Kind words can mend a sad heart.
- It is fine to make mistakes if we try again.
- Good friends listen to each other.
- Small helpers can do big things.

Requirements:
- Between 8 and 10 scenes.
- Each scene's narration has between 8 and 40 words, written in Tamil.
- The whole narration reads aloud in about 150 seconds at 80 words per minute.
- Short sentences, simple everyday words, warm and calm tone.
- The last scene says the moral word for word, then ends with this exact refrain: "அன்பாக இரு, துணிவாக இரு, நீயாகவே இரு!"
- "visual" describes what the picture shows in English, with no words, letters or signs in the picture.
- "camera" is one of: push_in, pull_out, pan_left, pan_right, rise, still.
- Mark exactly 2 of the most beautiful scenes with "hero": true.
- "sound_effects" lists zero to two gentle sound cues per scene, in English, like "birds chirping".
- "speaker" is "narrator", or a character id if that character says the whole scene.
- "questions" holds exactly 2 "What happens next?" style questions for children, in Tamil.
- "short_scenes" lists the zero-based indexes of up to 5 scenes that make the best vertical Short.
- "hook_line" is one gentle, curious sentence in Tamil that opens the Short. No clickbait.
- "thumbnail" describes, in English, one warm picture for the thumbnail with no text in it.

Answer with JSON in exactly this shape:
{
  "title": "...",
  "moral": "...",
  "scenes": [
    {
      "narration": "...",
      "visual": "...",
      "characters": ["kavin"],

      "hero": false,
      "sound_effects": [],
      "speaker": "narrator"
    }
  ],

  "short_scenes": [0, 1, 2],
